start.speaker: Bjorn
start.text: Hi. Yes. I was just passing by. For three weeks.

start.speaker: Imad
start.text: I've been talking to a bucket. The bucket had better answers.

start.speaker: Imad
start.text: Listen. You've got the legs, I've got the hands. Get me on your back.

start.speaker: Bjorn
start.text: I'd prefer to walk next to you. In a straight line. Forever.

merge.speaker: Imad
merge.text: That's a sneeze, not a name.

merge.speaker: Bjorn
merge.text: It's fine. It's a good sneeze.

tower.speaker: Bjorn
tower.text: I will try not to step on it.

boss_done.speaker: Imad
boss_done.text: It ran! The Roach Persuader works!

boss_done.speaker: Bjorn
boss_done.text: I would also run from you. With a broom.

end.speaker: Radio
end.text: ...survivors... if anyone hears this... the rail yard still has power. Bring filters...
